perk.masochism.name: Masochism
perk.matrix_hologram.desc: Creates a stationary illusion that draws the attention of enemies for %IDuration% turns.
perk.matrix_hologram.name: Echo Proxy
perk.matrix_interference_generator.desc: Creates an explosion dealing %IMinDamage% (%SDamageType:LocalizeDamageType%) damage within a radius of %IExplosionRadius%.
perk.matrix_interference_generator.name: Disruption Burst
perk.matrix_shield.desc: Grants a shield that absorbs %IShieldCapacity% damage.
perk.matrix_shield.name: Secure Shell
perk.med_auto_injector.desc: Grants %IHealthRegen% HP/turn for %IDuration% turns, stabilizes all wounds with a %FFixateAddedChance:Percent100NoPlus% chance to heal. Has a %FPoisonChance:Percent100NoPlus% chance to inflict Poisoning.
perk.med_auto_injector.name: Autoinjector
perk.medicus.name: Medicus
perk.mercury_arcane_escape.desc: Transfers the Pact wielder to a safe random location on the floor with no enemies within a radius of %IRadius%.
perk.mercury_arcane_escape.name: Incarnate Blind Shift
perk.mercury_astral_form.desc: Makes the Pact wielder immaterial and invulnerable to damage and knockback, increases the chance of shots piercing through by %FPierce:Percent100NoPlus% for %IDuration% turns.
perk.mercury_astral_form.name: Fana
perk.mercury_azure_shield.desc: Adds damage taken to the damage of all attacks dealt by the Pact wielder for %IDuration% turns.
perk.mercury_azure_shield.name: Sirri's Memory
perk.mercury_baron_form.desc: Transforms into a baron of quasimorphs from the Shartmakhum bramfatura for %IDuration% turns.
perk.mercury_baron_form.name: Hafizun's Face
perk.mercury_beam.desc: Fires a beam in the chosen direction that deals %IMinDamage% - %IMaxDamage% (%SDamageType:LocalizeDamageType%) damage, has a %FPierce:Percent100NoPlus% chance of piercing through, bounces up to %IRicochet% times, and travels a maximum of %IMaxDistance% tiles.
perk.mercury_beam.name: Barzakh's Light
perk.mercury_blink.desc: Transfers the Pact wielder to the target location and creates an explosion dealing %Explosion.Damage% (%Explosion.DamageType:LocalizeDamageType%) damage within a radius of %Explosion.Radius%.
perk.mercury_blink.name: Faris's Onslaught
perk.mercury_disintegrate.desc: Deals %IMinDamage% - %IMaxDamage% (%SDamageType:LocalizeDamageType%) damage to the selected target and disintegrates its remains.
perk.mercury_disintegrate.name: Solve et Coagula
perk.mercury_entropy_link.desc: Deals %IMinDamage% - %IMaxDamage% (%SDamageType:LocalizeDamageType%) damage to the target for %IDuration% turns after each AP spent.
perk.mercury_entropy_link.name: Barzakh's Price
perk.mercury_mass_displacement.desc: Converts all enemies within a target area with a radius of %IRadius% into allies and transfers them to random locations on the floor. Doesn't work on enemies not susceptible to eccollapse. Doesn't transfer immobile enemies.
perk.mercury_mass_displacement.name: Abd’s Turning
perk.mercury_meteor.desc: Creates an explosion over a random visible enemy, dealing %Explosion.Damage% (%Explosion.DamageType:LocalizeDamageType%) damage within a radius of %Explosion.Radius% after each AP spent by the Pact wielder for %IDuration% turns.
perk.mercury_meteor.name: Mujahadah
perk.mercury_prism.desc: Fires beams in all directions that deal %IMinDamage% - %IMaxDamage% (%SDamageType:LocalizeDamageType%) damage, have a %FPierce:Percent100NoPlus% chance of piercing through, bounce up to %IRicochet% times, and travel a maximum of %IMaxDistance% tiles.
perk.mercury_prism.name: Sirri's Eight Beams
perk.mercury_reflect_shield.desc: Reflects all shots that pass through the Pact wielder's space back to the shooter for %IDuration% turns.
perk.mercury_reflect_shield.name: Fukabirna Surface
perk.mercury_rewind.desc: Transforms into a senior flying quasimorph from the Shartmakhum bramfatura for %IDuration% turns and uses the %SPactId:LocalizePact% pact.
perk.mercury_rewind.name: In the Form of Mujtahid
perk.mercury_surge.name: Faris's Tempo
perk.mercury_the_world.desc: Makes the Pact wielder spend satiety instead of AP at a rate of %ISatietyPerAp% kcal per 1 AP, ending when reaching 0 kcal.
perk.mercury_the_world.name: Mujtahid's Fast
perk.mercury_time_stop.desc: Freezes all enemies within a target area with a radius of %IRadius% in time for %IDuration% turns, making them immune to external influences.
perk.mercury_time_stop.name: Hafizun's Ban
perk.mercury_times_marching_on.desc: Within a target area with a radius of %IRadius%, affected enemies take %IMinDamage% - %IMaxDamage% (%SDamageType:LocalizeDamageType%) damage every turn for %IDuration% turns, and items on the floor become spoiled and lose all durability.
perk.mercury_times_marching_on.name: Oblivion
perk.mercury_transportation.desc: Transfers the Pact wielder to the elevator leading to the next floor.
perk.mercury_transportation.name: Rihla
perk.mercury_vacuum.desc: Immobilizes all enemies within a target area with a radius of %IRadius% for %IDuration% turns and deals %IMinDamage% - %IMaxDamage% (%SDamageType:LocalizeDamageType%) damage to them every turn.
perk.mercury_vacuum.name: Abd's Sand Shackles
perk.mercury_vortex.desc: Creates an explosion dealing %Explosion.Damage% (%Explosion.DamageType:LocalizeDamageType%) damage within a radius of %Explosion.Radius%, which pulls enemies in the area towards the center and triggers again every turn for %IDuration% turns.
perk.mercury_vortex.name: Fukabirna's Pulse
perk.military_training.name: Training
perk.moon_animate_golem.desc: Summons an allied formerly greater quasimorph of the Duggur bramfatura who attacks the Pact wielder's enemies.
perk.moon_animate_golem.name: Voglea's Squire
perk.moon_animate_weapons.desc: Animates all weapons lying on the ground and in the hands of corpses within a radius of %IRadius% and forces them to fight for the Pact wielder for %IDuration% turns.
perk.moon_animate_weapons.name: Fokerma's Living Steel
perk.moon_baron_form.desc: Transforms into a baron of quasimorphs from the Duggur bramfatura for %IDuration% turns and uses the %SPactId:LocalizePact% pact.
perk.moon_baron_form.name: Ferrugo's Splinter Skin
perk.moon_dancing_blade.desc: Summons a sword mercenary of the Duggur bramfatura that attacks the Pact wielder's enemies.
perk.moon_dancing_blade.name: Serrava's Own Headsman
perk.moon_decay.desc: Destroys the equipment and inventory of the selected visible target.
perk.moon_decay.name: Ferrugo's Audit
perk.moon_die.desc: Kills one random enemy within a target area with a radius of %IRadius% with an explosion dealing %Explosion.Damage% (%Explosion.DamageType:LocalizeDamageType%) damage within a radius of %Explosion.Radius%.
perk.moon_die.name: Vincar's Sentence
perk.moon_disarm.desc: Deals %IMinDamage% - %IMaxDamage% (%SDamageType:LocalizeDamageType%) damage to a visible target and disarms them.
perk.moon_disarm.name: Fokerma's Cold Grip
perk.moon_disco.desc: Summons %ICount% sword mercenaries of the Duggur bramfatura that attack the Pact wielder's enemies.
perk.moon_disco.name: Forgeborns
perk.moon_iron_maiden.desc: Eccolapses an allied immobile lesser quasimorph of the Duggur bramfatura through the target, causing all enemies within a radius of %IRadius% of the target to panic.
perk.moon_iron_maiden.name: Vincar's Cold Warden
perk.moon_mass_decay.desc: Destroys all enemies' items within a target area with a radius of %IRadius% and increases all armor by %IResists% for each enemy affected for %IDuration% turns.
perk.moon_mass_decay.name: End of Dream
perk.moon_mass_disarm.desc: Animates weapons in the hands of enemies within a target area with a radius of %IRadius% and forces them to fight for the Pact wielder for %IDuration% turns.
perk.moon_mass_disarm.name: Mutiny
perk.moon_pain_wall.desc: Summons %ICount% Walls of Pain for %IExpire% turns within a target area with a radius of %IRadius% that absorb and store any shots that hit them.
perk.moon_pain_wall.name: Duggur's Pain Walls
perk.moon_psychic_resonance.desc: Deals %IMinDamage% - %IMaxDamage% (%SDamageType:LocalizeDamageType%) damage to all visible enemies and objects for %IDuration% turns.
perk.moon_psychic_resonance.name: Pacification
perk.moon_self_flagellation.desc: Forces all enemies within a target area with a radius of %IRadius% to attack themselves with their own weapons.
perk.moon_self_flagellation.name: Domitra’s'Compulsion
perk.moon_shatter.desc: Destroys the target object with an explosion dealing %Explosion.Damage% (%Explosion.DamageType:LocalizeDamageType%) damage within a radius of %Explosion.Radius% and summons an immobile lesser quasimorph of the Duggur bramfatura in its place.
perk.moon_shatter.name: Cauteris's Transmutation
